content.data: its been a while!! i took most of the blog down temporarily for some pretty rational reasons i think, but now i think i can put it back up. even if im still a little scared it might be oversharing.. but who cares honestly!! doesnt matter. i gotta wake up early for a C1 english exam tomorrow which sucks so i cant ramble as much as i usually do. but, two months later, im basically just as much of a confused mess as i was before!! but i feel like im making some peace with it. i feel like i can live with the chaos and knowing things arent 'perfect' or whatever. i can enjoy the little things throughout the day. look forward to simple parts of my day that are just.. nice. and i think maybe thats just kinda what matters. no chasing some higher state of being that somehow kills all my worries and fears. i just have to take things one day at a time and make the most of each. and enjoy it for what it is. without thinking about the future. whether or when it might be gone. so, for tonight, ill be thankful and enjoy my warm, big bed. and the warm cozy salt lamp i keep on at night because i am wasteful and selfish and terrible like that. and thats cool. and maybe whoever reads this can find something small to enjoy and be thankful for today too. food or rest or a reminder to drink water. be sure to drink water. please. i will be back... and i *will* ramble. just wait.

content.title: a sleep deprived bus ride back home

content.data:
a few days ago someone told me i overshare on here. it was honestly really embarrassing.. i was always scared this blog is way too personal and weird and silly and people think i'm a weirdo for it. but after a few days that embarrassment kinda stopped and i remembered why i do this in the first place. on the tiny off chance someone reads any of what i'm writing and relates. i feel like lately my problems have been kinda hyper-specific. regretting throwing away the good things life threw my way. well, when i put it like that it seems rather generic.. but i've had a couple people tell me they relate to what i write and feel, and even just one person saying that means the world to me. so i will keep writing these. not to mention its fun, and i think its cool!!
i joined this discord server for this artist i really like (weatherday) after finally finding an invite after ages. there they announced that this other server, a parannoul fan server, was making a compilation album for parannoul-inspired songs. i love parannoul and he's been a *huge* inspiration for the music i've been making. and there was still a whole month left for submissions. it also seems like all songs will get on, so i set out to make something *really* parannoul-inspired. and i got something im really proud of immediately. ive been working on this song for weeks, redoing vocals over and over, rewriting the text, working on the mixing. and tbh.. im not really happy with all of it. i feel like a lot of the parts in it aren't that emotionally hitting, unlike literally any parannoul song i like. but the ending is special.. and all in all i am still very proud of how it turned out. i would dare to say it is quite parannoul-adjacent and i submitted it a few days ago. comparing these vocals to my first attempts is totally crazy though. i am so so so so so far from being good at singing, but it's like, kinda okay now? i think? i am proud of where i've come. and what i've made for this. i will probably only properly upload it when the deadline is over at the end of october and the compilation is out with the final album art and all. but for now i will leave my final submission here on my website.
i wrote the text on a sleep deprived bus ride back home (also the title of the song). i went to aachen, a city on the border to the netherlands and belgium, to take a look at the city to see if i'd like to do my master's there. my roommate and i decided we would just take a bus there, pull an all nighter in the city, and go back the next day. it was kind of a terrible idea. i don't regret it, it was funny. i'd probably do it again. but it *was* miserable.. we found the shittiest sleeping spot on some university campus, and tried to sleep for 3 hours but maybe got in 30 minutes because it was too cold. i kept waking up because my legs got cold.. anyway, when i was on that bus ride back home, i was sleep deprived and getting emotional listening to music. and i realized i wanted to write something very vulnerable and personal for that song. so i let my thoughts wander and spiral and i just wrote down whatever i was thinking and anxious about and feeling like shit about on my phone's notes app. and a few days later i sat down to make a song text out of them with some minor adjustments, and i recorded it for the song. and the result is something that is raw and ugly and shameful and private and just a bunch of things i always think about but usually dont say because i am not sleep-deprived and can't think straight. its vulnerable and bad and almost none of it rhymes, but it is real, it is what i felt. feel. and im proud of it. and i hope maybe someone else can relate to any part of it too.

content.title: making shit for nobody but myself?? maybe?? but theres a plot twist?? and im not making it for myself after all?? but i also am?? help

content.data:
today is another one of those days where, after the millionth time thinking i finally lost it for good, i managed to make a decent-ish song again. i always have these dry patches where nothing works out and if it does its just snippets or im not fully sold on it. and this time is kinda like that again... this version i left for today is very rough, has loads of stuff i am really unhappy with, especially the first half. but it's an abominable fusion of two genres (rock and techno/edm??) that i know for sure nobody would enjoy. and that kinda makes it really special to me. because i like it lol. combining these more traditional genres with electronic music of various forms is a lot of fun and makes you mix elements together that i never thought would work. like the off-beat four on the floor bass with the acoustic rock drums.. idk. its tough to stick out ideas like this when they sound like literal garbage at first. and this still sounds like garbage in lots of ways. mixing is horrible, parts dont flow well yet, the melody in the first half sucks. but i am genuinely proud of how the part after like 1:36 turned out. that synth is literal crack to my ears. reminds me of some really old EDM i used to love as a kid. kinda of some songs that first inspired me to make music. the ones that also humbled me into oblivion when i tried making my first shit back in like 2016. god it was tough. it sucked. i sucked. but somehow i got back up and kept at it.. i seriously wonder how. kinda reminds me why im doing all this. for myself. and nobody else.
ive totally noticed how i kinda use music as this weird coping mechanism when i lose someone and i'm in denial about things being truly over. i fantasize about them checking out what i made and somehow understanding some of the feelings i put into it, and somehow maybe that'll suddenly change everything. or like if i do something impressive or get good at something, they will recognise that and.. miss me. i guess i just wanna be missed. know that i matter after all. won't be forgotten. things get lonely sometimes. and sometimes i wish that the person i try to push away just pushed back harder instead of giving in. like i dont truly want them gone. i just wish they finally proved i matter enough to not be an afterthought, but something they care about. and wont let go that easily. but.. that's not gonna happen. i'm some kind of adult and am responsible for my own happiness. just wish it was easier sometimes. and maybe one day someone *will* push harder.
anyway, i figure this blog is a decent place to put WIP previews of songs. so here you go. it is incredibly unpolished and i dont really like the first half of it, but i wanna put it out there anyway. to celebrate that i made *something*. didn't let the voices of doubt scare me off. and one day i will get up the energy to write and record vocals for all these songs ive been making. its so much work, its horrible. oh well. drink water, whoever may be reading this.

the last one or two weeks have been.. weird. i learned to finally seriously let go instead of staying stuck inside my head for all eternity. which hurt, a lot. and i feel guilty for it. but if i hadn't done it i would be stuck feeling like crap forever. now i can finally really move on and heal, and stop obsessing over things that'll never happen.
on a more positive note (well i suppose the last thing was positive? idk its complicated lol), im back into japanese!!! i stopped fully around february when i got out of a relationship at the beginning of the year. life happened, and so much was going on that i felt japanese just had to be put on the back burner. over 7 months or so, i had a good 3000 reviews pile up on Wanikani and Bunpro. This was obviously way too much, especially because a lot of it was recently learned items I already totally forgot, and a lot of it was also grammar where just doing reviews doesn't really cut it. so over the course of a few days, i went through all wanikani levels, until i hit a wall where my memory started to crumble. this was level 17, which is also the first level i didn't have any burned items on (that's the last spaced repetition stage, where you can recall something after 6 months). so i reset from level 25 to level 17, which is much better than fully resetting. on bunpro, i decided to basically do a full reset. i am now blazing through the early grammar just to make sure I still fully understand everything and don't have any gaps. and for vocab i'm going through the list again marking any items i still easily know as done. i'm hoping with this strategy i'll be right back where i left off after 1-2 months. its been fun though. i started a little study blog on the bunpro forums to hold me a little accountable for my goals and im looking forward to staying on it this time. i mean i studied pretty much all of 2024, with a couple lack-of-motivation-breaks in between. but now i really wanna stay locked in and focused. now that i have nothing else to obsess over its a lot easier, and probably good for me..
also did my first ever contribution to an open source project!! i just did some bugfixes for these premid discord activities for wanikani and bunpro and added some more info and a setting to hide them when reviews+lessons are done. so like, nothing special or anything. but it still feels kinda cool. to have my name in there forever, contributing to something ive been using for a while. was also fun learning how to do that all properly with forking and making a pull request and all. it actually just got merged today after being reviewed so yeah!! kinda wanna try looking into contributing to some other projects i use, like my favorite music player. i '''''''''learned'''''''''' typescript for these contributions so hopefully that'll be a bit easier now (i bet typescript is super cool but i kinda just cheesed my way around all the features that are supposed to make your code better lol). in general its kinda cool to know that nowadays, whatever i wanna do or learn, i know i have the knowledge and skills to get into it. i just need to set aside some time and learn and then i can do it. like, going to uni actually taught me a ton of shit and gave me skills, and thats really cool. i suppose this is what education is supposed to do and im glad it worked out lol. kinda makes me scared of doing my master's at a regular uni (currently at a uni that's specifically focused on being practical). it'll likely be sooooo much more theory. but i wanna challenge myself. prove to myself i can do it. that im not just cheesing my way through this degree by going the 'easy' route or something. and see what proper academia is like. maybe i'll enjoy it and i will wanna do my phd?? who knows. being a professor one day is still that peak dream of mine... oh well.
practicing guitar has been inconsistent... the other day i made an entire song with basically just my guitar playing (i think i added one piano in the background maybe) and that was cool. i made some other things but theyve all been meh.. i made this one mashup/cover of two songs from this tiny artist i like, and i thought it was kinda cool. and i sent it to them. they replied to my first message and said i should show them and then they never replied hahahahhahaha (pain). thats been hurting a bit. especially in combination with just generally not putting out good stuff lately. for some reason i feel like i was on such a roll a month or two ago and now i'm scared if i dont make use of it i'll lose it. or maybe i already lost it. i feel like i need to get better and make more stuff to be respectable and proud. but, i am so proud of the things i have made. my high school best friend simon randomly saw i uploaded them on my birthday and listened to them and he said he really liked some of them. he said 'i wanna travel the cosmos with you' almost made him cry. that felt.. so nice. so no matter what, i have something to be proud of already. and i will just do whats fun and feels good. thats what matters. i tell myself. but it still feels bad. idk. whatever.
ive been so confused about how im feeling. when people ask me the only thing i can say is good, because thats true. most of the time i feel alright. im chilling, doing what i enjoy, going out whenever i feel like it, but theres something at the back of my head telling me something's.. off. or wrong. and idk what it is. i guess its the fact that i gotta just really live for myself for once. nobody to run after or give me a sense of purpose. its just me and myself and my goals. but that still feels a little hollow sometimes. i hope i will get used to it. i have so much i wanna do and achieve. i guess i get kinda frustrated because i cant possibly do all of it. so i will always think of some thing i'm falling short on, and it'll make me feel like all my other focuses are worthless and i'm really trash. idk. its tough.
either way, ill keep going. like always. and i will try to be content with where i am. and happy with what i am doing. i dont really have much of a choice, after all.
0001.jpeg

ive been feeling something for the first time. im just kinda.. content. with where i am. and where i'm going. i don't want to be with someone, rush into the next thing. at least i don't feel any pressure to. which is different from how it's been my whole life. i kinda just wanna focus on myself, my own life, my future. and tying myself to someone feels.. exhausting, intimidating, not worth the effort. im not sure how long this will last. maybe this will go over in a heartbeat. but it feels nice to just.. sit in the moment for once. be happy with how things are. appreciate my room, appreciate my warm bed. not just look for the next thing to get into. and ill take things slowly, and as they come. im done running around looking for things for a while i think.. i have everything i need. also finally back to learning japanese again. hoping to be roughly back where i left off in february in less than a month (apart from grammar that's gonna take a bit longer). so exciting..

some nights are hard to get through. it's seemingly random. some nights i am so happy, so content with life and where i am. and on others, i just feel empty and alone and sad. longing for something that isn't there. not even knowing what exactly it is i'm longing for. i wonder if there is a strategy to tipping the odds in favor of having more content nights, or maybe this is just how things are meant to be. i tell myself to take things slow and live with how things are. but sometimes i wonder if i really can. maybe my life *is* just chasing after things perpetually. maybe that is the point of living. if you have all you want, then what do you live for, after all, maybe. well, you'd live for the thing that you have and want.. kind of a stupid question. but like, how could one ever just stand so still. it seems hard to imagine. i guess i was kinda in that exact spot. and i chose to let go and go back to my old life of wandering aimlessly trying to find out what i need to be happy. i wanna cynically joke about how shitty of an idea that was, but it really wasn't. it was a good choice. and while this all sucks sometimes.. on those dead, lonely nights, like this one.. at least i'm growing. somehow. getting an inch closer to figuring it out each day, maybe. whether the answer lies across the atlantic or right in front of my feet, with time i think i will get there. and until then, i just take things day by day, slowly. do what i can in the moment to feel happy. reach out. distract myself from my silly mistakes and stupid messages i wish i could unsend. and head to bed in this comfy cozy safe room i've built and earned for myself. because no matter what, i have that. and i can dream of a miracle happening that just magically solves all these problems for me, maybe. and i will be okay. what a month it's been.

but like, really. properly. i think ive unlearned that. sometimes i wonder if i even can. maybe this is just who i am and this cycle will repeat infinitely, over and over. maybe i am somehow destined to long for the same things and make the same mistakes. maybe i am constantly sabotaging myself and my happiness. but what happiness is there to begin with when it's all tainted by my longing for something more. i think i could have everything i want and still be restless looking for the thing to make me complete. and i dont know if this will ever fix itself. if i can fix it. or if it needs fixing. maybe this is just how i am and how i operate and that's okay.. or maybe i'm so stuck in this loop, this bubble, that i can't accept letting go of it. i feel myself slipping into the same cycle i've lived through so many times, all my life. and i have a hunch where it's going. except that hunch is telling me nothing will change, and i will end up here again. alone and confused. maybe that's not so bad. but it kinda is.. idk. moving on is hard. moving on is even harder when you know you couldn't get over it for years to begin with. there are things i wish i could say, thoughts i wish i could put out there. sometimes i wish i could just say fuck it and let go of everything. but thats all just me hoping saying it will change something. that saying it will somehow make things great and happy and i dont have to feel so bad after all. sadly thats all a lie. sometimes i really truly wish somebody could just take all these worries and thoughts and put them to rest. just say all the things i want to hear, all the things i've been wanting to hear. and make me forget reality. or bend it to make things fine. but nobody like that exists. nobody is here except me. nobody can help me, not in that way. but they can at least be there. and make things a little less lonely and horrible to sit through. and i should approach those people more and not spend as much time in my own head. still. in my head, i will always still be hoping for those magic words that just make everything right somehow. it's a comforting thought. and i'll deal with that hope dying one day when hopefully i have this stuff all figured out a little better.

content.title: it might as well be the end

content.data:
i broke up with the person i got together with back in 'sometimes i wanna just stop thinking'.. so my emotions have been all over the place recently. it's honestly really tough. i try to keep myself occupied at all times. yesterday i went to uni at 8:30am and went home at 11:30pm. just so i don't rot away at home and feel bad, i suppose. this morning we talked for a bit and that made it worse, but letting myself cry over it felt a little good too. anyway, i started my day intending to study. actually, i wanted to listen to some of the songs i made recently to see if i could relate to the lyrics now with the.. change of situation. and i could. there's something very interesting about listening to your own lyrics after you've gained a bit of distance from them. you realize how interpretable and unclear they are. when i wrote them i thought they'd be super specific and clearly show what i was thinking. which was scary. and made me hesitant to share them. but i literally know how i meant them and could still feel them in a different context this time so clearly they're not that rigid. anyway, listening to those songs got me motivated to work on music.
at this point i realized that today there is an event i've been looking forward to for a while. there's this competition called 'all nighter' from artbyFORM that happens yearly. it's this 24h competition where people make songs in all sorts of genres and they make a compilation album with 45 picks out of them. last year i did try to participate. and it went abysmally. i couldnt come up with anything and everyone else was making such amazing stuff. i felt like trash. but i told myself i'd actually try next time. and that time came so much quicker than i imagined. anyway, it was noon and it started at 4pm. so i was really split. but i felt i needed to make something *right now*, so i did. i mostly finished something, i think. started recording vocals. i was almost thinking about whether i could just submit this for the competition, but that's against the rules. which was frustrating because i felt there was no way i was gonna make something as good again. but, 4pm rolled around. i was nervous as hell. seriously, i dont even know why. its so weird. but 4pm struck, and i started a new project. it started off really weird. but i kept going, pushing through, thinking maybe i'm """cooking""" as everyone in the server puts it. i feel like i'm 50... anyway, i keep going and it's coming along. and it's coming along more. and i record vocals and they're the best ones i've recorded yet (as every time i record vocals lol), and the song is even better. and it's not dragged out. and. i'm proud? i made something i like, something good. something i can actually submit. now i don't wanna get my hopes up about being accepted, there's so many super high quality submissions and if i got in i'd just be super lucky. but, there is the tiniest speck of hope in me that i might get on.. that would be amazing. but, either way, i made something i can be proud of. i didn't chicken out, i didn't fail. i tried, i pushed through and i am happy with it. and i'm so proud of that. it took me ~6h to finish it before the polishing i'll do with friends' feedback tomorrow. speaking of which, someone just told me it sounds like something you'd put on as background music.. ouch. but tbh i kinda just disagree lol. when i got back from watering the plants and listened to the song i was kinda disappointed. it just didnt really make sense the first time i listened. it had that effect where you write a melody and it only sounds right to you becuase you're used to it but the second you step away and forget it, it makes 0 sense. but after listening once i really liked it again. i'm thinking maybe it was that way because i listened to it so much before the break? idk. idkkkk. who knows. maybe it'll just not be accepted and in reality i made garbage. but that song is how i feel, and it means a lot to me. it feels nice to think that people could connect to that and appreciate it maybe. but even if not, it was still worth it. and i'm proud of myself. sadly i can't upload the song until it's decided whether it'll be accepted or not.. but i can post the lyrics here, because they describe how i've been feeling lately, with the breakup and all. a bit overdramatic, as i tend to make all my songwriting, but here it is anyway. i guess i post (shitty) poetry now...

i wanna see the sunset with you by my side
but i will fall asleep alone tonight

puke out my guts
how do i heal from these deep cuts?
i wish you could ease my mind
always think of you
can't believe that we're through
i wish you were by my side

come back and hold me in your arms again

i wanna see the sunset with you by my side
but i will fall asleep alone tonight
i don't wanna be alone again
without you it might as well be the end

and that shall be the end of this post. i'm sure with time i will be okay. i'm sure..

today i felt an emotion i haven't felt in quite a while. it's this everlasting dread of the future that has sort of followed me my whole life. i will wander through life aimlessly for ages and end up unhappy longing for something i don't even know, and eventually i'll finally think of some paths that sound like they would make me happy. and then i think about how to get there. and within minutes my excitement goes from filling me with energy to draining every last bit of hope i have left in my body. i think of all the steps and hurdles and how i can't even begin to think of how to approach any of them, and that's all next to all the other things i already have to worry about. and all that coupled with the uncertainty of whether it's really the right thing to do. it's so frustrating. i guess this is what being an adult is.. approaching difficult things on your own. i used to take refuge in the fact that i always had people to go to with these worries and anxieties when they came up. that i wouldn't be alone in figuring things out, and if it was all too much, i could just tune it out. but i've become much more isolated in the way i deal with these things, and i feel like i should be able to handle things on my own. not that anybody could even help in the first place. nobody will ever do any work for me and at most others are a shoulder to cry on when it's all too much. but idk. i'm just so tired. there's all these dreams but they're all so far away and reachable yet.. also not. at least seemingly. i'd call myself silly for worrying about all this stuff when things are so far away and its only really worth it to worry when the time comes, but like, when some of those things require preparation months or years in advance, it reaches a whole new level that just completely paralyzes me. so i end up laying down in bed, trying to forget everything. wishing i could at least distract myself properly. find some happiness in the middle of the dense fog of doubt and disappointment. but a lot of the time, there's just nothing there. or i have no energy to reach out for it. oh well.. i'm hoping that maybe, with time, i'll be able to get where i wanna get. and even if i am lazy and miss out on stuff now by putting it off or something, it's not the end of the world. i still have quite a while left to live, i hope. so i'm sure it'll all be fine after all. and whoever else might be reading this, i'm sure you'll get where you wanna be too. just stay hydrated, eat and get through each day one day at a time. that's what i'll do, at least for today. oh also, i worked on a new waveform seekbar feature for the music player.. kinda cool...

i should be happy. and i am? but i'm also not. i feel so conflicted and confused, every day. i think about my situation, the life i've built up for myself. and how cool and nice it is. how i realize that right now i'm in a time i will look back on very fondly. but then i think of my future. where i will be in a year. how quickly this will all go over, and how quickly i will be in a completely different spot. a town that's not as nice. a university or job i don't like as much. different (or no) friends, i think about how summer is slowly coming to an end. how it'll be winter soon and it'll be grey and depressing and sad again. i wonder how i'll do. in the past winter has definitely taken a toll on me mentally. so i hope maybe this time won't be so bad. but still. idk. its like every day i'm living in a situation that i wish i could capture and relive forever somehow. and instead of being happy, i get sad and scared. i also just feel.. alone, often. i rarely talk about these thoughts and feelings with anyone. because i feel like they can't do anything anyway. what would be the point.. and that's really stupid because i know even just talking about it already helps a little. but idk. i often think back to the last few years of my life and ask myself how i could have come all this way and still just feel alone. and i wonder if that will ever truly go away.. maybe this is just what life is. i mean it is kind of what i chose for myself, too. and i dont necessarily regret it? idk. yesterday on the way back home from uni i cried. it was 8:30pm, i had spent all day at uni studying semi-successfully, and i walked instead of cycling because i wanted to walk with my roommate on the way there. but i was walking on this path along the vineyards, walking towards the sun setting behind a hill, with clouds being lit from behind. and i just stopped walking for a bit and thought about where i am in life, and i just felt so hopeless and alone for a second. i stood there for a few minutes just silently crying, before continuing walking home. and i haven't even told anyone about it. and that.. sucks. i often wonder what i need to be happy. and i wonder if i am happy. i dont even know what being happy means. and i dont know how to ever get there. and i often wish someone could just take all those worries from me and make me happy or something. but idk if that'll ever happen.. idk. writing this felt good though.

it's been a while since i last posted. uhm, its really been a while, what.. two weeks?? its been that long since i worked on all the website stuff?? god.. what did i even do in that time. i mean, i worked a bunch on uni projects. with the semester coming to an end, a lot of projects are wrapping up and i am almost constantly working on those, on and off. which is quite exhausting.. especially because the finish line on most of them is rather blurry. but hopefully i will get them all done by the end of the week, at which point that big thing i talked about in 'anticipation' will happen. so then ill be gone for around two weeks.. im sure itll be nice after this rather stressful period. i am gonna be travelling around germany for a few days, and then going to amsterdam and paris. ive been to amsterdam once when i was around 16 and didnt like it much at all, but i think it's because it was for a student exchange and i didn't like the people there much at all. that whole exchange was really weird tbh.. and if i remember correctly, when they were eventually at my place (it was less of an exchange and more of a visit), i was just out cold with a fever the whole time.. god that's all so long ago now. 7 years. either way, i strongly suspect i will love amsterdam this time around, so i can't wait to go there. and i kinda never really thought i'd go to paris.. it never interested me too much and it also seems kinda intimidating. but now that its planned and i know im gonna go im actually super excited. i have no clue what to expect really but i am quite sure i will have a great time. i just hope the deadline on one of these projects im working on wont be delayed so i dont have to hold a presentation on collecting and analyzing data on fuel prices at 8am in a hotel room in paris... oh well. earlier today it really sounded like that would be the case because it seemed like my group was the only one which wouldn't be free on the later date, but i randomly saw this guy at uni who was doing the same module and he has the same problem as me, and i was so incredibly happy, because if two groups can't do it he will probably let us do it on the original date. so im really praying that works out.. even apart from the paris thing, i just really badly want it over with. one of the other projects technically has its deadline in a month but i got it to a point where i will just upload it and let it sit and see what happens.
i worked on music again yesterday. im semi-happy with what came out.. just like last time tbh. ive been trying new things and theyre just kinda weird.. i kinda make them thinking i will put vocals on them eventually and maybe thats just what theyre missing. but then i kinda just never put vocals on them, and i leave them mediocre and unfinished and thats.. weird. ive never had that problem before. usually i always pump out a song in a day or two and ive got a finished product i can just be happy with and appreciate. but this way is.. weird. its like i put in all this work for nothing? nothing to show for all my effort. and its a weird feeling. its kinda sad.. on the other hand, at least i had this little snippet from what i made yesterday, and i showed that to a few people because i thought it was really pretty. and they were all really nice about it. im honestly really scared to share my music with people directly.. im not too scared of uploading it, but actively telling people 'hey i made something look' is terrifying to me. am i annoying? what do they think? what if they hate it? can i ask them to spend this much time on listening? am i obnoxious? is it desperate? it all races through my mind uncontrollably and fills me with such fear. about sending people something i care about and made. something i spent hours on that takes 3 minutes for them to listen to. obviously if we're talking about random people i would never expect them to even put in 3 minutes, but since these people care about me i should know that they are nice and would want to listen. its silly for me to be so scared. but i guess in a way its almost natural. its really scary putting something you made out there like that, especially when youre so critical of it yourself. and with something like music its even worse than most other forms of art. everybody can appreciate a nice drawing or painting, i think. but with music most people are only into such a tiny little fraction of everything you could possibly make. and what if what you made isnt their thing? are you wasting their time? annoying them? putting them through something they dont like? the aspect of asking for their actual time makes it really scary. they're really *investing* something when they decide to listen. an image is looked at in an instant. and idk.. its just all complicated and weird. and its kinda sad. i feel so passionate about some of the music ive made. and theres just nobody to share that excitement with for most things.. not because people dont care, not because what i make is bad, but because tastes are so different and matter so much. and i wish there was a solution. but i guess there isnt. it also doesnt help that im into so many different genres, and a lot of the stuff i make isn't even part of what *i* usually listen to. so how could i expect anyone else to. and on the other hand id say, okay, these songs are just special to me, and thats what matters. but of course i care about what other people think too, of course i would want other people to listen and hopefully emotionally connect on some level. because being alone with that feeling is just.. lonely. and sad. and cold. and it feels nice any time someone says they enjoy literally anything ive made. then again, how would i even know they like it, of course they're always gonna say they like it. but i'm getting too cynical here.. my friends care and they wouldn't lie to me. i'm sure they do like it when they say they do, and thinking or worrying about anything else isn't helpful or healthy.
anyway, ive got a lot to look forward to these next few weeks. i wonder where they will take me, and what memories i will be making. oh oh i bought an instant camera for the trip!! the ones that print a photo right after you take it. i am so looking forward to it.. im kinda sad i had to get this really basic model because instax (the cheaper and in a lot of ways better alternative to polaroid) stopped making square-format instant cameras that are any more advanced than the most basic stuff. but honestly depending on how much i like this one i might get one with their mini format.. sure its really small, and its portrait, and that feels kinda eh, but honestly, why would they need to be big. if its really small maybe you can even just carry it around in your wallet all the time. which is really sweet too. i just really like the idea. analog photography generally just seems really fun and cool and i am excited to finally get into it, even if its in this really gimmicky way. but the thing is, i could never pay for analog photography with film and all if i just take photos normally. i could never justify that. but if i make photos for someone else? i can totally pay a euro per photo. it means something, after all. and i think that means that for the foreseeable future i will be sticking to limiting my analog experience to instant cameras. theres also these ones that take a photo digitally, and then there's an led inside that prints a photo you choose onto the light sensitive film, but that kinda feels like cheating.. but i will see. im just looking forward to getting it for now.
i also used my hardware synth properly for the first time since i got it.. i was really scared this was another useless expensive purchase for a while, and i doubted my decision to doubt my old decision of selling my old one. but i will totally use it whenever i make music, and i wanna make lots of music!! having some breaks is okay too. i just dont wanna go multiple months or a whole year without making anything again. that would be sad. i also wanna get into embroidery soon!! i wanted to already do that ages ago to prepare a gift before i will be busy for the next few weeks, but it'll have to wait now. and thats okay. also gotta practice more guitar again.. ughhh so much to think about and do!! projects for now. thats plenty. and this has been plenty too. take care, whoever reads this. even if its just me. drink water!!

content.title: a little post about this website

content.data:
for once im gonna make a post on an actual topic instead of just my silly scrambled thoughts!! i originally made this website as just a little collection of links i could put on all my profiles for convenience. i actually got the command line idea out of nowhere... sure, im far from the first person to ever think of it, but it still felt nice to come up with someone completely on my own, rather than taking the idea from somewhere else. i think that's helped to make this website really feel like *mine* over the last few years, which is nice. over time it slowly evolved, but really, it mostly stayed the same. i updated links and added some fun features like a command history and clearing the screen (which i *constantly* do while i work on it or navigate it). but i never truly did much. but i always told myself id like to do more. i always liked the idea of having my own little blog on here. i liked the idea of social media, like twitter. where you can just kinda plop down your thoughts and document your brain and life in a way. but doing it on social media was never appealing to me.. it didnt really feel personal, and i didnt like the idea of the more random, thoughtless nature of short posts. not that theres anything wrong with that, but it didnt feel like what i wanted. so i dangled the idea of adding a blog to this website in the back of my mind for ages. the biggest hurdle was honestly feeling like i didnt have any right to make this.. why would anyone ever care to read what i think or have to say? would anyone seeing these think that i'm full of myself for thinking anybody cares? they're silly, but powerful thoughts, that kept me from pursuing this idea for a long, long time.
one day a while ago, i think while i was finishing work on my last ep, i thought about where i upload my music. soundcloud is stupid because it has a limit on the amount of music you can upload, and i was slowly approaching that, actually. so i always thought about what id do once that day comes. switch to another account? how would i link the two? which one would i link on my website? bla bla bla, it was all just kinda stupid, and i thought, fuck it, why dont i just move everything to my website. and with that burst of motivation and energy, i implemented the 'music' command.
it was actually a lot of work... sadly a music player doesnt quite fit the command-line theme of the website, so i had to make a slight exception with the player at the bottom of the screen, as a fixed footer. but after a while, i got it working, and im quite happy with it. making a custom audio player in html is actually a huge pain... different browsers have entirely different players and styling them is an absolute nightmare. i mostly copy pasted some css, deleted the parts i didnt understand and adapted the parts i really needed. hence, the player is pretty simple, visually.. but it works!! which is really cool. a large part of the process was actually getting the files onto the website to begin with. this website is static and has no backend, so i had to do with simply leaving the audio files somewhere in the repository for the website to load. i have all my music scattered throughout folders with names like 'finalv8master.wav' and obviously i cant just copy those over, so i had to rename all of them to their names with underscores for special characters. i also converted them all to 192kbps opus for that sweet, sweet audio quality.. no more shitty soundcloud compression.. good riddance.. (its seriously so bad). but a large part of this whole idea was that i wanted this entire thing to be low-maintenance. i didnt wanna make the music library some hard-coded html that i would need to copy and expand each time i add more. the solution i settled on is creating a JSON with all the necessary information the website needs to generate all the HTML by itself. for music, this basically means i made a list of 'music items'. this can either be a single or an album, which is noted in the 'album' field of the item as either true or false. a single has more info to it like, the name, date, genre and length. an album has the same, except there is another list of songs contained, each of which has a name, genre and length. the JS code basically goes through this JSON and generates HTML dynamically to represent the contents of the JSON. the links to the real files are generated automatically too, as the song files and song titles match, just with special characters and spaces turned into underscores. so this means that if i want to upload a song to my website, i just have to transcode the file to opus, put it in the 'songs' folder, add an entry to the JSON, and it shows up on my website!! (oh and the cover works basically the same).
shortly after i was done with this, i started work on this blog feature. it actually came together super quick - now that i got away from the super non-command-line-ish music stuff, the blog feature worked super well in this format, and when i originally made this i actually made it very easy for me to come back and work more on it. i made some helper functions to print text and links and everything and i got it done in an hour or two. after which i immediately wrote the first blog post on here!! the blog posts are also just a JSON file containing objects that each have a title, date and content. so for a while, that was kind of it. i left it there and was pretty happy just writing some posts on here every now and then, and ive been really proud of how it turned out. it really does feel like my little corner of the internet that i can do whatever i want with.
yesterday, i was at uni and kinda bored and i realized that the link to my plushies was just an imgur link to an album there. which kinda sucks.. so i thought, surely just doing that on my website shouldnt be too hard.. sure, images dont *really* fit the whole command line aspect, but it should be pretty easy. and it was!! i took the plushie images off imgur, scaled them down to be more web-friendly, and put them in a folder of the repo. i then noted down all the file names in another JSON, which is convenient, because i actually wanna display the exact file name on the website because it looks cool (or something). so now, each time i wanna add a new plushie, i just have to put a file in the folder, add the file name to the JSON, and there it is. originally, this was just a vertical list of images, and it only had the names above the image. i later changed them to be shown in columns, and i added the date, but i'm getting ahead of myself...
now just today, i wanted to finally tackle my whole photo situation. ive uploaded them on flickr for ages, but i never liked the website. its slow and kinda sucked and.. its flickr. thats weird. also too close to my name.. ew. anyway, i had a few problems. flickr had albums, and it had a whole CDN to make sure you get the right size for images and it works as a website. and like, there's so many files... hundreds of photos. i ended up with this strategy: i have a photos folder, then make a folder for each album, and within each album, i name the files sequentially, so 0001.jpg, 0002.jpg etc. then, if i make a json with the name of the album, date and number of images, i can just loop through all numbers and insert the images on the website, and display the album. i made the default 'photos' command just display the most recent album and a list of all the others. but im thinking of maybe adding a preview image for all other albums too, just to make it a bit less of a wall of text.. i used this weird css property named column-count to turn the image gallery into a thing that covered the whole screen, rather than a vertical line of single images. and i honestly really like how it looks.. i do wish the images were *ordered* horizontally rather than vertically, if that makes sense, but for now this is totally fine. so at this point, i have my music, my blog, my arts and crafts projects, and my photos on my website. thats kinda everything i do/make??
one problem this whole website brings is that.. how would anyone ever know i put anything on here. a few days ago i tried to remedy this a little by picking the first blog post in the blog JSON file and displaying the date at the top of the page. however, if i uploaded music, photos or a new plushie, this wouldnt do much. so i wanted my website to look at all available content, and display the date of the newest one. so far i always wrote down the dates in a pretty format in the JSONs, like '25th of june, 2025'. but if i now wanted to automatically compare the dates for all content types, that wouldnt work. so i changed all date fields to some ISO standard that looks like '2025-06-25'. but like, this is totally not aesthetic and sucks and blegh.. (apart from the plushie display, because i think next to file names it looks kinda cool). so i made a little function to convert that to a pretty string again, which is used in most places on the website. but with the new format, i can now compare the newest element of each content type (blog, music, photo, plushie), and update the top of the page accordingly. so if i add a new blog post, itll automatically show up at the top of the page. same with new music, new photos or a new plushie. this might seem a little overkill? because i could totally just update the main page directly each time i upload something. but i have this huge urge to make this website as low-maintenance as absoutely possible. and now i dont have to do anything - i just have to focus on putting the right file into the repo, update one JSON, and i'm good to go.
so yeah. thats a little peek into what ive been doing on here.. expaning my little corner, maybe turning it into a side with time. i like the idea of accumulating stuff on here. this is my space, and nobody can take it from me, and i can do whatever i freaking want on here!! this website is almost a presentation of everything i made, everything i care about, everything i am. or at least with time, i want it to become that. and i think with the work ive put in, ive made it as easy as possible for me to do so. i wonder if i will ever get tired of this idea and make another website.. with all the ideas figured out now it honestly wouldnt be too big of a hassle, but still definitely a lot of work. sometimes im scared people might not understand how to use the website, but all my non-techy friends told me its totally fine, so that's good. there's some more things i wanna do. i wanna add high-res versions of my pictures to the website that you can get to by clicking on each picture, i wanna turn the plushie wall into more of a general arts and crafts wall, and i wanna add a feature to recall commands with the arrow keys, because god i try to do that so often and it always messes up my brain when it doesnt work.. anyway. this was long, but i like writing posts like that. makes me proud. for some reason. not sure why.. anyway, i will now save this JSON, and watch my website update exactly how it should, without any extra work!! and hopefully soon i'll upload something more. gotta grow that corner.. and if you're reading this, thanks for stumbling into it and taking a look! it means a lot. thank you. in fact, maybe you're the reason this place even exists. for the couple of people who would ever be insane enough to take a look at it.. yes i called you insane. im sorry. i take that back. youre actually really great. well, with the aria season 2 outro track coming on just now, i will say goodbye!! so goodbye. and take care, please. drink water.

im looking forward to this big thing that's happening in a few weeks. ive been looking forward to it for a while, and its really exciting!! but the excitement is always slightly dampened by this looming fear of what comes after. lately ive been looking back really fondly on my time in japan and the usa, i set my desktop background to a slideshow of pictures i took there and every time i see one i feel this little ache inside of me... this longing to go back, this deep desire to just, please, be there again. its bizzare to think i took those pictures, i was there. and yet, time passed, and i am here again. and what now? does that mean the good time i had is over? is it just a fact of life that we have to keep coming back to normalcy? is that bad? is it good? having something to look forward to almost makes me feel like i have a reason to.. live. a reason to go on, a reason to think that even if im not happy right now, i will be soon if i just wait it out. but what comes after? i will look for the next thing to look forward to. i will chase another thing to keep me afloat, give me a reason. and maybe thats okay... its not like my everyday life is bad. its nice, actually. but i do wonder if this is just what life is, or if this can somehow change. is there a way to wake up every day and go 'im right where i want to be', and not need something distant in the future to keep one going? maybe this idea is silly. you cant just be happy all the time. and the grass is always greener on the other side, or you always want what you don't have, or whatever other sayings there are. but i cant help but think that, maybe it is possible... maybe there is a way for me to live life that makes me live for the day, not for the thing in the future im hoping will happen. i dont know what that way would be. i dont know if it exists or whether i even could ever get there if it were there. maybe it takes a lot of courage to even find out, courage i might not have.. but it is interesting to think about. and i hope one day i can feel some of that excitement for where i currently am in life. until then, i will look forward. and when i come out the other end, i will find the next thing for my brain to latch onto, and so on. and hopefully, with time, i will learn what i want and need, and i will be able to see if maybe i can make *that* thing my normalcy. maybe that is what chasing a dream is.. hm. havent really used that word for anything i felt in a while. so, i will dream!! or try to. i'll try my best.

content.title: something not negative for a change

content.data:
i just took a look at my posts and kinda realized that almost all of them are about something negative. i usually write them when im sad or feel bad about something, and it usually helps a lot!! and i do end up kinda happy with the ramblings. idk how they come off to others, maybe they seem pretentious or silly. but i find it really interesting to see my thought patterns kinda laid out so clearly, and i find value in reliving them, so to speak. when i journal on paper, i write much more slowly, and what i write isnt quite as unfiltered. i always have to choose which thoughts are worth writing down. when typing on a keyboard, its much more.. raw. and unpolished, for sure. i wonder how much sense a bunch of the stuff i say makes, to anyone.. but the stuff on here is special to me and i feel kinda proud of putting those raw thoughts out there a little. maybe its a bit embarassing, but maybe, just maybe, someone can relate to some part of it and find some value in it too. and if not, at least these are therapuetic to write lol...
today was pretty good though!! got into horror games a little bit over the last few weeks and that has been a lot of fun. i used to always be way too scared, but i think some exposure to the genre together with others has helped me not freak out quite as much. i finished signalis not too long ago which was really really good (although most of the story kinda flew over my head...), and ive been playing silent hill 2 now, after trying and failing to pick it up about two years ago. its been really really great, and im excited to just generally play more games. just the other day, i randomly booted up pseudoregalia, which is this ps1 looking 3d platformer i played 1 or 2 years ago, and i just finished it in the same day. which was.. so nice. that was such a great day, and i literally felt productive. instead of sitting around wasting my time not even knowing what i did all day at the end of it, i decided to spend my time consciously on something i genuinely enjoy and i just enjoyed it. i want to do that more. i have been trying that with friends a bit. many years ago i was on this whole train of 'just ask people to do stuff randomly, if they say no its fine, it doesnt matter', and it was great. i just randomly watched anime movies with people and i had such a great time. made many great memories. in the past few months i have been trying to bring that back, and with decent success, even. i kinda failed to do it tonight (which is maybe why im writing this whole thing), but earlier today i *did* ask a friend to watch an anime and he said yeah and we watched like 3 episodes. so i still count today as a win. its also kinda weird.. with two of these people, its always me asking to do stuff. and i often hear people complain about this sort of stuff. like, they wanna feel like the other person wants to do stuff with them too. and i absolutely get the feeling. i used to feel that a lot too. but for some reason, i just cant bring myself to care this time around... i ask and a lot of the time they say yes, and they seem excited too, and we always have a great time. so what if its always me asking... ill gladly ask. i mean sure, its nice to be asked too. id never complain about that. and one of my friends does it, which has pulled me out of some ruts sometimes, and im super thankful for that. but idk, i just cant really get myself to care about it or feel bad about it.. which is obviously good. or maybe it isnt? maybe this is a sign of a lack of self worth.. because, quite honestly, i dont feel like i have any right to expect anyone to want to do anything with me. and that might sound bad. but in practice it works out quite well. i think it makes me more pleasant to be around and more collected and rational about these things, which in turn hopefully makes people enjoy being around me more, which just ends up as a net positive? maybe? nah im way way overthinking this lol. its really not that complicated. i just feel confident in the fact that my friends like me even if they dont ask to do stuff. maybe theyre shy, maybe they dont know if im free and dont wanna bother, maybe they struggle with the same things i do and just cant get themselves to take the intiative. either way, im fine with it, and id rather do that than assume the worst.
another thing i really learned the last few days is how helpful and important communicating openly and honestly is. i had a lot of thoughts that were stressing me out because i believed they would somehow be unsolvable problems or something. but even just talking about them in a safe and calm environment made me realize they really werent that bad at all, and i can manage them. in general, its just always a bad idea to hole myself in. be it in terms of what i do day to day, or emotionally. friends are such a great thing to have. i often envy people who have really close great friends, or a strong friend group, or whatever. because throughout most of my life, i kinda always felt i dont really have any of that. and i always catch myself trying to look for more, for new people, for me to feel like i finally have 'enough'. but ive come to realize today that, i absolutely have enough. i have more than i could ever ask and wish for. i have really great friends that i know care about me, that i know are always happy to do stuff with me or hang out, and whenever i need someone, i can just go to them. idk why my brain always reminds me of the things i might not have and tries to convince itself im in a shitty position that needs to change.
another thing ive been thinking about lately is how i separate irl friends and online friends. when i came back from my traveling and settled down again for the semester, i had a little spree of irl social interactions. i felt really determined to have irl friends to do things with and i wanted to be less online. but over time this has kinda changed. irl im only really close to my roommate.. quite close for that matter, hes a great friend and (obviously) always there. but sometimes i wonder if maybe im cutting it a bit close with just one friend. one day we will move apart and go different ways. will my online friends be enough to keep me happy then, until hopefully i find someone to connect with like that irl again? maybe i will fall back on other people, even if im not keeping up those friendships much right now. maybe they wont be there and im losing them all by not putting in the energy i should. or maybe ill just be okay.. like i kinda always have been. mostly. my online friends wont go anywhere, and my roommate will always still be there by text or call as well. maybe im just overthinking and worrying too much again.. i think i am. but still, i find it interesting that i have come to appreciate my online interactions so much again. to be honest, thinking about it, if these friends just stay here, and i get to do the same stuff with them forever.. id be fine? that sounds nice. i dont need much else. maybe it is okay to be a little terminally online. it honestly fills me with joy, and ive been really happy about that part of my life. and the other parts are alright too. who knows. maybe this will change with time, maybe it wont. im just happy im happy, right now. things are good and looking up. the future looks exciting and fine and ill just take things as they come, im sure i will figure them out somehow, no matter what. i have to!! so i will. ill be fine. this was long.. but it felt good!! now off to water the flowers outside at 11:41pm and head to bed..

content.title: sometimes i wanna just stop thinking

content.data: actually, usually its not so bad, but its really hitting me right now. which is why im writing this actually. im hoping it'll get my mind off stuff a little.. sometimes i feel so overwhelmed. a day can go so well but you just have to think the wrong thoughts at the wrong time, they chain together and keep inviting more to come and its just really overwhelming. usually when I get into patterns like that I try to talk to friends, or I distract myself somehow. something that usually helps me a lot to vent my feelings in situations like that is music. but its so freaking frustrating when even music makes me feel worse because i compare it to my own and think about how bad i am and how much better i wish i was. that feeling really fucking hurts, to be honest. everything kinda hurts. i often put on such a tough front and pretend like everything's fine and great, but it isn't. i worry and struggle a lot and its a constant battle to keep my spirits up and stay happy and hopeful and stable. not that it isn't working, for the most part. it does and i would say i'm generally happy and things are good. but god it feels good to admit to myself for once that things aren't easy and that i'm struggling and feeling these things. i feel a bit relieved after having written that. i wonder if anyone ever reads these. not like id expect anyone to, but itd be nice to think these thoughts arent just thrown at a wall nobody cares about. i often wonder about what i should or shouldnt put on here, whats appropriate. honestly who cares lol. the vast majority of people wont read it anyway and i feel like the few people who would are close enough to me to where i shouldnt be embarassed or worried about anything. i got together with someone recently!! and ive been very happy about that. i'd be lying if i said it wasn't tough to adjust. letting myself rely on someone and get so invested in someone again is scary. and my brain constantly reminds me of all the things that could go wrong. all the worst case scenarios, all the tiny things i interpret into huge disastrous signs. luckily those feelings have been getting better, bit by bit. i often feel like i handle them pretty well. but when lots of things come together to overwhelm me, it can be quite tough. because it just adds to this chain of unproductive and hurtful and bad thoughts. but im happy. really happy. ive known them for so long and im really excited to finally get a shot at this. i have had this weird sort of embarassment about long distance relationships my whole life... like i think people will think its stupid or silly or whatnot when i tell them. i really wonder where that comes from. because that thought is stupid.. and doesnt feel nice. i wanna be proud of it because im so excited and happy. but my brain just jumps to conclusions, assuming the worst, which is totally silly and stupid. because like, even *if* that were true, that people thought it was silly... why would i care?? why would that matter? i guess this is that ancient problem of caring about what other people think. i guess the obvious answer is just that it isnt that easy and its normal to be worried and you can just try to be a bit better about it. or maybe you really can just stop giving a fuck and stop caring about what others think. or can you? i feel like some people do that, and i admire them. idk if maybe those people were just born to be like that, and im not, or whether i can get there too. am i insecure? ive asked myself that question for a long time. i used to say im somewhat confident in myself. i see some value in myself and know i have some sort of worth, and that gives me enough confidence to like, get through life and whatnot. but do i really truly deeply love myself and all parts of myself? idk. not really. i doubt myself too often for that. talk myself down and compare myself to others. and there we kinda go full circle i guess... maybe im just insecure. maybe i just need to be more confident in myself. who i am, and the things i make. maybe i should stop comparing myself to others or social norms. not maybe, i totally should. its obviously the right answer. but really, its hard. its really, really hard. i tried reading this book earlier this year to kinda help myself with that stuff.. i wonder if i should try again. but im doubtful i can just learn to love myself and be confident in myself by reading a book. or maybe i can. i suppose it wouldnt hurt to try. yeah, i think thats the right conclusion to come to. idk. i am super ultra rambling right now but it feels good. i feel a weight off my shoulders compared to when i started writing this. a heavy weight. a suffocating, drowning weight. and now i feel a bit lighter, just barely floating atop the water. which is a good place to be, i think. im okay with it, at least. thank you, visual studio code editor window, for being here and listening to me. and thanks to anyone who would actually ever read this, if anyone. if you do, i appreciate you. and pls dont think im weird or judge me or hate me and block me and tell everyone how stupid i am and jqwklejqweklnqlwne <3

content.title: i have no clue what i want to write

content.data: i have no clue what i want to write. but i want to write something. its been too long... well, how long has it been? 9 days. i guess a lot has happened in the last 9 days.. so maybe thats why it feels like a long time. sometimes i feel myself wanting to make things or write things that my brain immediately rejects because itd be too embarassing, or i feel like it's someone else's thing and i wouldnt do very well. i know thats a silly thought but its hard. i wonder if this stuff ever gets easier.. will i ever just make stuff i wanna make and share it, without any of those strings attached? or is this maybe the nature of making art thats close to you? the fact that its vulnerable and putting it out there is.. risky. i mean, what if someone thinks its stupid. what if they think less of me for it. cringe at it, cant stand through it. my brain immediately jumps to 'who cares about them that doesnt matter' but honestly, i dont think thats right. it does matter. i care about what people think of the stuff i make, and i want them to like it, to get something out of it, even if its just tiny. itd be a lie to say i only make stuff for myself. so i suppose thats just how it is.. itll always suck and be hard and you just have to try to learn to deal with it. to make it and share it anyway. i think i do an okay job at it, relatively speaking.. uploading that last ep really took a lot out of me. it was embarrassing as hell. i beat myself up over it for days, cringing at myself and being mad at myself for not just leaving it on my hard drive forever. but now that some time has passed, nothing happened. the world isnt over, my friends dont hate me. maybe somebody thought it was embarrassing and bad? but even if they did, i didnt hear or notice. and a few people were nice about it and said some nice things. which is kinda exactly what i wanted and was hoping for... but idk. its just hard. but i hope to learn. and get better. with time. i guess even just writing this right not and putting it on here is already a bit of an achievement.. i was scared of starting this whole thing too after all. but here i am only half embarrassed each time i write and upload a post. maybe it does get better....... who knows!! i dont.

content.title: why do i want to travel

content.data: before this year, i never traveled much. i was comfortable staying where i was and traveling seemed expensive and exhausting. earlier this year, traveling to the US and then japan within roughly 1.5 months, i got my first taste of what it was like. and since then, i find myself constantly thinking about where i could go next. i barely even think about spending my money on anything else, and i have lost all sensitivity to how expensive it all is, because it was so special. but i wonder why i feel this way. why am i so focused on getting away. why am i so desperate to relive that high, that sense of adventure. am i trying to get away from something? am i looking for something i dont have? what do i hope to gain from it all? maybe i am overthinking it. traveling is fun and cool and its only natural i would wanna do it again. but i do wonder what exactly i liked so much about it. i went to japan alone, and the thought of traveling with someone else in the future sounds nice. but finding someone to do that with also seems hard. i wonder if ive been thinking about all this stuff too much, blaming myself for having these feelings. like i should be happy with less, with what i have. but maybe thats not true, maybe its okay to long for things, work towards them and enjoy life that way. or maybe its a balance. its probably a balance... idk. either way, im sure eventually ill have an opportunity that feels fitting and worth it. and then ill go for it for sure!! until then, ill take it slow and just see what happens.

i wonder what i want from life. for most of my life i thought i lived for connecting with others, for the type of connection i was craving. recently ive felt other motivations. living just for the sake of living, of creating, of experiencing new things and enjoying the way life unfolds itself. but its conflicting. because sometimes the former shines through and it makes me doubt whether the latter really is enough. and life just cant always be exciting and eventful. sadly, it feel like the two options are almost incompatible. you cant have stability and commitment as well as spontaniety and novelty. or maybe you can. but i totally tend to just settle down and become complacent with the way things are and not changing anything.
maybe im just too afraid to commit, to make the same mistakes ive made in the past. there is something beautiful about both ways of living and i feel like it would be cool to commit to something if i felt confident about it. maybe theres no point in worrying about all this to begin with.. its just a choice id have to make whenever i actually have the choice. but until then its still weird to think about. wish life was just a little easier.. or maybe it is and im just making it hard for myself. this year has already been so eventful and its not even half way done, so i think ive done a decent job so far. and im sure ill make the best of whatever comes. but i wont settle on any particular way of thinking for now, and ill see where life takes me. i think thats the best approach.

making art is hard. i know this feeling of opening up fl studio and only making complete unusable garbage all to well. following some weird idea without it going anywhere. and yet, it still always makes me feel as useless and incapable as it did when i started making music. it makes me feel like im incapable of making anything, like i finally lost it, like ill never be able to make something good again. and that feeling sucks so much. as always, i will come back another day when i feel more into it, and i will make something i am proud of again. but until that day my mind is tainted by this frustrating, sad experience that is so annoyingly irrational.
ive also felt such a strong urge to branch out into other genres and stuff. i wanna make the stuff ive been enjoying so much lately, but it sucks. its hard to try out new things. when i first started making music, everything i made was utter useless garbage that nobody would ever wanna listen to. and that felt bad enough to the point where i just stopped making music for years. im still not sure anybody would actually listen to any of the stuff i make, but at least i can find some value in it. but when trying out new things, its just as hard again. but i suppose its worth it. it was worth sticking around back then and its just a matter of trusting the process. maybe i need to do that again... or maybe part of the problem is doing this all alone. its kinda sad to think ive only ever done this stuff completely alone. i wouldnt even know how to involve anyone else in the process, but i think that would be nice. idk... its all weird. and complicated. all i know is that this feeling sucks. but i know that in a few days or weeks, i will start up fl studio again, and maybe that time will go better. and maybe one day ill finally genuinely make something that i can be proud of, something that i want to make. one day.

change is scary. even getting used to shitty situations is often more comfortable than confronting myself with any chance of things changing. but obviously that can't be good for you.. or maybe it is. im not sure. things are confusing!! but taking a step feels nice. not knowing whether its the right or wrong direction is weird, but at the very least you're going somewhere, not stuck in the same safe space. good things can only come from change and daring to leave that place of comfort. or maybe it's not about the good things at all. maybe its just about finally not standing still anymore. maybe change is what makes life good. who knows. im confused. i always will be!! but thats okay. i dont need to understand. but im not gonna stand still, ill take things into my own hands and deal with the consequences. because, at the very least, i know im trying and i know im alive. that has value in itself.

i guess this is my first post here lol.. hi!! whoever may read this. im making this whole addition to my website along with the music part because i got motivated by a person i will refer to with the codename toolf (whoever that may be), but ive been meaning to do this stuff for a while, especially the blog part. i worked on the music part for quite a few hours and then spit out this blog feature in like 30 mins... but it was fun! i havent really done any sort of coding in a while. even though i study computer science. how sad. its also worrying how little i actually did myself.. almost everything was just copying code. i understood almost all of it but like, i totally couldnt write it from scratch without taking 100x longer looking everything up. definitely giving me a bit of impostor syndrome, but.. whatever. im sure its fine!!
the features i worked on are far from perfect (didnt care to implement the mute button for the volume control), and the whole input prompt is causing some scrolling issues on mobile, but at least it works.. i think ill embrace that this website is more of a desktop experience and just try to make sure mobile at least works.
releasing thoughts like this is weird. who am i talking to? who am i thinking will read this? will any of the people who i think will read it actually read it? what would they think? is this a kind of diary? isnt the whole point of diaries that theyre private and you can write whatever in them? am i supposed to be fully honest and open here? where is the line?
idk. so many questions. but thats okay!! this is just a fun little place i can put random stuff on. and if its embarassing or dumb, ill delete it!! but hopefully not. thanks to whoever might have read this. please send me cute cat gifs. and have a good day pls!!
